question: Two current white PET-GF covers break during light assembly while an older white Sculpted cover tolerates the motion.

historical_white_set.note: The September log identifies the submitted white set and successful source STL. The retained editable snapshot provides the historical process; its readiness file labels the full-plate slice pending, so it is not presented as the submitted archive.

geometry_comparison.sample_scope: X-direction material intervals at S12/24/36 and N8/10/13/16/19 in each cover's own display frame. This is a local section comparison, not a complete minimum-thickness or stress analysis.
unchanged: 1.25 mm top inward preload per wing
1.513 mm bottom inward preload per wing
-50 degree CAD X cover print pose
changed: Neck radius 13.012455 to 13.5 mm; skirt width 28.924911 to 29.9 mm
Rear lower skirt extends 1.2 mm aft with a revised sloping rear opening
Total cover volume 3621.97 to 3803.46 cubic mm
geometry_comparison.finding: Sampled lower wing sections differ by at most 0.014 mm near N8; the upper sampled sections are slightly thicker. No wholesale thinning appears in these samples. The broader neck and rear closure can change stiffness and required motion; their effects are unmeasured.

leading_hypothesis: Continuous 70 percent part cooling may reduce interlayer bonding in this thin flexing part. It is a plausible cause, not established by the observed breaks.
alternative_hypotheses: Rear closure and broader neck alter flexibility or insertion load
Filament moisture, feed or nozzle condition differ from the September print
Local seam or support-removal damage; the fracture plane and exact break location are not supplied

manufacturer_guidance.relevant_guidance: 280–310 C print temperature; cooling fan off; slower printing for layer-adhesion issues.

prepared_trial.variable: Part cooling only; fan_min_speed, fan_max_speed and overhang_fan_speed all zero
prepared_trial.next_physical_reading: After cooling and support removal, load the display and seat the complete cover on the matching current Sculpted tip using the documented sequence. It must survive that normal motion without a crack and retain the display and cover. Record underside quality as well, because cooling is used for overhang finish. This result establishes that assembly only.

recommendation: Test the current geometry with part cooling off before adding thickness. A thicker flexing wall also becomes stiffer, so thickness alone is not a controlled cure for assembly fracture.
